findings.note: An Oct 28, 2026 report says Ekholm missed two games with an undisclosed injury and had only a goal and three points in 10 games. Its news feed also shows a later RotoWire item saying he would miss at least a week, so check his status for tonight.

The Oilers' own preview says Edmonton goes for a seventh straight win at Tampa and lists Ekholm among the NHL's plus-minus leaders. That suggests he is active and playing a big role, but the preview gives no specific lineup or injury confirmation.
Ekholm had 24 assists in 65 games in 2024-25, and his coach describes him as a top-pair, shutdown and penalty-kill defenseman with only part-time power-play work. That role limits his assist chances.
ESPN lists him as a Blue Jackets right wing with 2 goals and 8 assists in 18 games in 2026-27, but only 1 assist in 6 road games; this is a road game. The page's date is uncertain.
NHL.com's projected lineup for the Nov 17 game at the Islanders had him on the second line with Voronkov and Fantilli. I found no lineup or injury news for the Chicago game itself.

Covers shows he had assists in 3 of 6 games from Nov 3 to Nov 14, including Nov 14 against Philadelphia. Over 0.5 assists closed around +210 to +250 in those games, and the season average is 0.44 assists per game.
